The '''Pica Rim Pipeline''' was an extensive [[Water/Legends|underwater]] transportation system that lined the floors of [[Albrae-Don/Legends|Albrae-Don's]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the pipeline was [[Attack on the Pica Rim Pipeline|bombed]] by the [[Justice Action Network]] destroying over 4,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] worth of track in protest of the execution of [[Earnst Kamiel]].
